prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 9:16 vertical direct-flash fashion editorial portrait of an adult woman with long dark straight hair, composed expression, and natural luminous skin. She wears a black long-sleeve velvet midi dress with high neckline, opaque black tights, simple black low-heel pumps, and small plain hoop earrings. Seat her upright at the center of a broad carpeted staircase, ankles crossed, hands resting lightly on her lap. Place her in a grand neutral foyer with pale marble steps, patterned runner, ornate dark railings, and a large golden-lit holiday tree. Balance direct camera flash with warm chandelier and tree light; use eye-level full-body framing, controlled highlights, clean marble texture, natural skin, and accurate hands. No lingerie, fur trim, body emphasis, logo, readable décor text, or watermark.
